def dump_cache(self):
    if not self.cache:
        return 0
    head_freq_node = self.freq_link_head
    if head_freq_node is None or head_freq_node.cache_head is None:
        return 0
    self.cache.pop(head_freq_node.cache_head.key)
    head_freq_node.pop_head_cache()

    if head_freq_node.count_caches() == 0:
        if self.freq_link_head == head_freq_node:
            self.freq_link_head = head_freq_node.nxt
        head_freq_node.remove()
    
    return mean(freq.freq_node.freq for freq in self.cache.values())
